title: Product title layout verified
summary: Checked the full Armani product heading on narrow mobile, mobile and desktop layouts.

changes.detail: Verified the natural-case, semibold product heading without truncating product size or condition information.

validation.name: Responsive browser
validation.detail: At 320px and 390px the heading uses 22px text with 28.6px line height; at 1280px it uses 30px text with 39px line height. Full title retained and no heading overflow at all three widths. Inspected 390px screenshot.

validation.name: Limitations
validation.detail: No physical-device or full-site regression run. No deployment.
